title: Agreement before entering the simulation phase
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $t$ be a natural number. If the run of the mapping machine in non-forward setup mode, started on $x$, has not entered a state representing a simulated state of $M$ at any time $u<t$, then its configuration at time $t$ is identical to the configuration at time $t$ of the mapping machine in forward mode started on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
the non-forward run has not entered the simulation phase at any time u < t
